latest.title: Z-Deck 0.2.63-cyberdeck

preUpdateBackup.reason: A/B app-only OTA does not write NVS, LittleFS, or SD; manual SD backup remains available as a separate queued action.

latest.notes: Improves physical-screen readability with larger solid app badges, high-contrast glyphs, opaque tiles, and restrained borders while retaining the startup and restore fixes. App-only A/B OTA never overwrites MeshCore, NVS, LittleFS, SD files, channels, keys, or local preferences.
